asks: Which calls may a plugin use?
answer: A plugin can do nothing until a rule allows it. Its declaration lists the rules it needs. Which calls Silo offers is settled when they are built. They touch four areas: the record (reading a part of it), opinions (giving one), the app (showing a panel) and the user (putting a question).

sets.means: A view of the record, in the app.

sets.says: A plugin can do nothing until a rule allows it.

suggest.why: The owner said it: what a plugin needs is a set of rules, shown when it is imported and switched on when it is installed.
